summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the immediate resignation of CFO Mr. Yung Chi Man, accepted by the board on October 5, 2026, for personal reasons with no stated disagreements. The board simultaneously appointed Ms. Liu Liangping, 44, as CFO effective immediately; she stepped down as Chief Operating Officer, a role she held until that date, and is the spouse of director/CEO Mr. Ma Biu. No financial terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks apply. Watch for governance concerns over related-party board dynamics and any subsequent 20-F disclosure or accounting restatement risk.
